::: {#exm-language-model}

#### A uniform language model

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
uniform_the = (1 / n_chars) ** 3
print(uniform_the)
```

The simplest [language model](#def-language-model) for this text gives each of the `r py$n_chars` characters probability $1 / `r py$n_chars`$ at every position,
whatever came before.
It gives `"the"` probability $(1 / `r py$n_chars`)^3$,
or 1 in `r format(py$n_chars^3, big.mark = ",")`,
the same as any other string of three characters,
such as `"qzx"`.

:::
